name: dobe_lean_idle
subject: huge muscular doberman made of glossy pink paint goo with yellow streaks, three-quarter view facing right, lower body melts into a puddle
desc: as if shoved, the upper body sways far back toward the upper left in a big exaggerated way and both arms fling up and out, the head tilting back a little while the face stays clearly visible and exactly the same: same long muzzle, same narrow half-lidded yellow eye, same closed mouth with a slight sly smirk. The puddle at the bottom stays still. Same colors, same size
